commit.message:
Fix velocity polygon uncovered-velocity warning throttle (#6560)

RCLCPP_WARN_THROTTLE takes the throttle duration in milliseconds, so
2.0 limited the "Velocity is not covered by any of the velocity
polygons" warning to once every 2 ms and it was logged for every
cmd_vel message. Use 2000 ms, as the other throttled logs in
nav2_collision_monitor do.

Assisted-by: Claude:claude-opus-5-5

Signed-off-by: Lim-jooyoung <mmporong@gmail.com>
